metrics.window_convention: WP-12at / WP-S2c-11 uses the next prior contiguous equivalent-length non-cloned evaluation window, 2024-04-12 through 2025-04-11, as the second additional H-001 D2 observation after the original full-period no-formal-split baseline. Indicators are warmed up on prior available history, but the backtest window starts flat with no pre-window position carry-in. The original H-001 REP-0002 evidence used a full-period retrospective posture, so strict non-overlap against that baseline is impossible; this package follows the later repo precedent of explicit non-cloned window disclosure for additional REP evidence.

data_provenance.source_data_notes: OL-0017 derives from REP-0017. REP-0017 used the prior contiguous equivalent-length non-cloned evaluation window, covering 2024-04-12 through 2025-04-11. Indicators were warmed up on prior available history, and the backtest window started flat with no pre-window position carry-in. This window is distinct from REP-0016 final-local-data-year evidence. The original H-001 full-period baseline used a no-formal-split retrospective posture, so strict non-overlap against that baseline is impossible.
